$schema_note: Draft for the Le Chat connector directory (beta). Fields and required keys may evolve; align with the latest official schema before submission. Not yet submitted as of 2026-06-21.
name: fortranspire
summary_en: Port legacy Fortran 90 HPC kernels to OpenACC GPU and Cython (Phase 1) or differentiable JAX (Phase 2). Built on ECMWF Loki for deterministic AST analysis; the LLM only intervenes where semantic understanding is required (~4 calls per kernel).
summary_fr: Porte des kernels Fortran 90 HPC vers OpenACC GPU et Cython (Phase 1) ou vers JAX différentiable (Phase 2). S'appuie sur Loki (ECMWF) pour l'analyse AST déterministe ; le LLM n'intervient que sur les étapes sémantiques (~4 appels par kernel).

auth.scope_note: Static API key provisioned by the connector operator (env var API_KEY on the MCP server). The connector directory passes it to Le Chat as a secret.

tools.title: Estimate the GPU-port cost of a Fortran kernel
tools.description: Deterministic pre-flight estimate: routine count, structural risks (I/O, hidden state, loop-carried dependencies), GPU-portability and JAX-portability verdicts, and an approximate token cost for a full port. No LLM is called; no token is consumed.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The Fortran source text itself (not a server path — a hosted server has no access to the caller's files).

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: Optional name, used only to pick the dialect from the suffix (.f fixed form, .F90 triggers cpp preprocessing).

tools.title: Analyze a Fortran kernel for GPU-portability findings
tools.description: Static Loki AST analysis of inline Fortran source. Emits FORT0xx findings — blocking I/O, SAVE state, non-smooth constructs, missing INTENT — the same way the CI analyzer does. Handles legacy fixed-form F77 and cpp-conditional .F sources. No LLM, no token.

privacy.data_handling: User-provided Fortran source is sent to the MCP server's configured LLM endpoint (Mistral La Plateforme by default; can be re-pointed at a self-hosted vLLM/TGI on-prem). The agent does not persist user code beyond the run unless the operator configures a workspace volume.
sub_processors: Mistral La Plateforme (default LLM provider; configurable)
privacy.data_residency: EU when using La Plateforme; fully on-prem when self-hosted
privacy.deletion_policy: Outputs are written under output/ inside the operator's workspace and are not transmitted further; deleting the workspace volume deletes all artifacts.

compliance.sovereignty: EU — no Azure / AWS / GCP dependency on the LLM path.

submission_checklist: Public HTTPS MCP endpoint reachable from Le Chat (OpenStack tenant or on-prem)
Bearer auth enabled (API_KEY env var set on the server)
Demo video or screenshots of a sample kernel transformation
public_surface_note: Only deterministic, zero-token, zero-write tools are exposed to the public directory. The token-spending pipeline tools (translate_kernel_gpu, translate_kernel, ask_agent) run the operator's LLM key and write files, so they are reachable only over a local stdio connection or an authenticated private deployment, never from the public connector.
